mapper.insert: INSERT INTO compliment (match_id, rater_id, ratee_id, comment) VALUES (#{matchId}, #{raterId}, #{rateeId}, #{comment})
mapper.select: SELECT compliment_id, match_id, rater_id, ratee_id, comment, created_at FROM compliment WHERE rater_id = #{raterId} AND match_id = #{matchId} ORDER BY compliment_id DESC
